title: Few small primes suffice to cover unit groups
summary: Klurman, Shparlinski and Teräväinen showed that there is a set of at most $(\log Q)^{1+\varepsilon}$ primes of polylogarithmic size whose subset products cover the unit group $(\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z})^\times$ for almost all moduli $q\le Q$. We show that $(1/\log2+o(1))\log Q$ primes suffice, which is optimal to first order, since $m$ primes have at most $2^m$ subset products.
